name: super-post-agent-kit
description: Two focused skills and one local MCP bridge for safe pending-data intake, publishing existing rows without duplication, reusable groups, campaigns, scheduling, and result tracking through Super Post King.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Super Post King with one skill for pending data intake, reusable groups, cross-platform campaigns and target mapping, and another skill for settings-driven scheduling, publishing and result tracking.
defaultPrompt: Show my Super Post profiles and groups.
